title: Breadth-First Search
teaching_content: BFS explores a graph level by level using a queue. Start at a source node, visit neighbors, then neighbors-of-neighbors.

question.prompt: Which data structure does BFS typically use to track the next nodes to visit?

source_references.excerpt: BFS uses a FIFO queue to expand the frontier one layer at a time.
Breadth-first search visits vertices in order of increasing distance from the source.
